<!-- pr-reviewer: 84b2bdf1ed014fb4038564f6f47a865907e8fb5c -->

Reviewed by SlaveSession (agent, collaborator account, not the author). Head 84b2bdf1e. Verdict: clean. Outside PR: the maintainer approves and merges by hand.

**What I read.** The full diff, `ribbon_cell.rs` in place, the three new tests, `docs/decisions/2752-ribbon-cell-fill.md`, and the moved code in `painted.rs`. Trial merge with main a8d923108: clean.

**The change is right.**
- `cell_box` extends the fill and the click target to `label_bottom + 1`, clamped to `cell.bottom() + max(0, ribbon_caption_gap - 2)`. The ribbon has one cell row (`ribbon_h`: tab, top gap, `cell_h`, caption gap, caption row, bottom gap), so the box cannot collide with another cell row; the caption clamp matches the pin `ribbon_rows.rs:51` (`cell_h + ribbon_caption_gap >= label_bottom + 2`).
- Label ink now follows `contrast::on_fill(fill)`, the same rule the glyph uses; a plain cell keeps `text`/`text_faint`. Disabled keeps the alpha 115 path.
- `fit_label` moved unchanged; it lays out with a placeholder ink and the galley call passes the real ink. The label geometry does not depend on the ink.
- `cell` re-exports from `painted.rs`, so callers do not change. `painted.rs` is 370 lines; the new module is 120. Provenance and ASD comments are in place.

**What I ran.** `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1251 passed; the three new `ribbon_cell_fill` tests pass. Four `frame_cost_probe`/`frame_cost_caches` tests fail; they fail on main at this same line (`frame_cost_probe.rs:278`) and are tracked by #2762 (fix in work). They are not caused by this PR: this diff touches no preview or pick-cache code. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Screenshots.** The body carries one composite before/after headless render, and says the author did not look at a windowed run. Accepted per the UI-screenshot rule; the fill edge is the point of the change, and the light-theme case is visible in it.

**Not exercised by me.** The WGSL/wasm path is untouched. The `.diff.png` note at the cut is correct: a PR must not change snapshot PNGs, and this one does not.
